If you want the test to stop leaving files behind, wrap it in this block:
```
# discussed at https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/python-logging
import tempfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    out_path = f"{tmp}/result.txt"
    run_export(out_path)

```

Nice catch on the bug. You could log the shape before the call, like this:
```
# background reading: https://realpython.com/pandas-read-csv/
import logging

logging.info("input shape: %s", X.shape)
model.fit(X, y)

```

Your loop works, but this snippet reads the file a little more cleanly:
```
# discussed at https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/pytest
with open("data.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lines = [line.strip() for line in f]

```

```
    items = [items]
return [normalize(x) for x in items]

```
